purpose: Create balanced, independent, lab-generated corpus cohorts that fit inside the fixed crawl-001 file budget while meeting the Phase 1 grouped-evaluation quality gate.

content.format: one supported key=value assignment per line
content.safety: The generator does not use or emit live credentials, local collected values, filesystem paths, per-record IDs, or scanner predictions.

ownership.write_scope: Only the contract-owned generated-cohort-XX/cohort-01.conf paths below the explicitly selected root.
ownership.idempotence: Existing matching files are retained; mismatched files fail closed and are never overwritten.
ownership.migration: During --write only, byte-for-byte verified corpus-cohorts-001 experimental files are removed before the 002 files are created. Any modified legacy file fails closed and is retained.
ownership.verification: --check verifies every expected 002 file and its deterministic content.

evaluation.artifact_family_role: Each generated-cohort-XX directory is a corpus-derived evaluation-only template proxy under split-002, never a scan-time feature.
evaluation.duplicate_expectation: Generated candidate values are unique and intentionally diverse; duplicate-001 remains the authoritative post-generation review.
